brief:
The UK will announce a range of policies on Israel including a ban on goods from Jewish settlements in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. The measures are under discussion within the British government as part of a broader shift in approach toward the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Details of the full policy package remain limited, but the settlement goods prohibition represents a significant step that would restrict imports from areas considered illegal under international law. The announcement is expected in the coming period as Britain reassesses its position on Israel and occupied territories.

title: UK prepares settlement goods ban and new Israel policies
